en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Isa, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Muhammed bin Abi ‘Umayr, from Mansur bin Yunus, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Ali bin Hussain, peace be upon them both, that he said:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Verily, do not be lured by the one who extends his upper arms with blood, for indeed, he will have, from Allah, a killer that does not die. They said: O Messenger of Allah, and what is a killer that does not die? He said: The Fire.
